name: loop
title: Loop until {{params.check}} passes
description: Prompt an agent, then run a check after each of its turns and send it the failing output until the check passes or the rounds run out.
tokens: The prompt you give, once. Each failed round sends about 90 characters plus the check's failing lines and tail, at most 3 KB. A resume sends nothing again.

check.description: the command that must pass (exit 0) in the session's worktree

prompt.description: the first prompt; empty runs the check first

timeout.description: how long one agent turn may take
